1.5.Title: Class of Recommendations and Level of Evidence
1.5.Details: Terms and definitions used are consistent with the American College of Cardiology Foundation/American Heart Association methodology.

3.1.Title: Diagnostic Evaluation
3.1.Details: Provides guidelines for optimal medical therapy with or without percutaneous coronary intervention. It references clinical outcomes utilizing evaluations and assessments (e.g., COURAGE, BARI 2D trials).
Key Studies: Shaw LJ et al's work on left ventricular function and ischemia.
Zellweger MJ et al's studies on prognostic value of coronary assessment.

Statistics: Tsa CV et al's heart disease trends 2022.
Fihn SD et al's management guidelines for ischemic heart disease.
